what: Words that are ALWAYS typed with an asterisk in a caption, in every video of both modes (the user, 2026-11-14: "words such as fuck, faggot, pedo, shit, gay and more always write in captions like f*ck, f*ggot or similarly"). Only the typed caption changes: the spoken word stays in the audio, nothing edits audio. This file is the user's own list: add or remove a word here and every later build follows. A word heard in one video that is not here goes in that video's EDL, captions.mask_terms (exact lower-case forms), and `cc.py captions` is run again.
how: ONE asterisk takes the place of the first vowel after the word's first letter (fuck -> f*ck, shit -> sh*t, faggot -> f*ggot, pedo -> p*do, gay -> g*y, bitch -> b*tch); a word with no such vowel loses its second letter (ass -> a*s). Punctuation and case stay (the captions are upper case later: F*CK).
anywhere_note: A word listed here is masked wherever it sits inside a spoken word, so its forms and compounds come with it: fuck -> fucking, fucked, motherfucker, fuckin'; shit -> shitty, bullshit; pedophil -> pedophile, pedophiles. An entry written bad[ass] masks only the part in brackets and only inside that longer word (badass -> bada*s), so class, pass and assume stay as they are. Only list a stem here that no everyday word contains (therapist contains rapist, so rapist is below).
whole_word_note: A word listed here is masked only when the whole spoken word is exactly this one (any case, punctuation around it ignored): a short or ambiguous word whose letters sit inside everyday words (ass in class, dick in Dickens, pedo in torpedo, cunt in Scunthorpe, coon in raccoon).
